summary: Merchant Portal 'ENTER A DELIVERY' (manual single-order entry) tested end-to-end at 375x667 on the preview URL, plus a light backend re-check. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed: consent required (400), pharmacy run required (400), bad phone (400), cross-store 403, half window (400), unauthenticated (401), and create followed by a GET to confirm it was saved (MC code, batch_run, no _id). Frontend, pharmacy mer-2 (books@): the 'ADD ORDERS' section with ENTER A DELIVERY sits above TEMPLATE / UPLOAD CSV. No run gives the toast 'PICK A PICKUP RUN FIRST'; a run but no consent gives 'TICK THE PRIVACY CONSENT BOX FIRST'. In both cases the sheet stays closed. With a run and consent the sheet opens with new-delivery-run 'PICKUP RUN: AFTERNOON BATCH TODAY ...', and the date, window and matter fields are hidden. Errors in the sheet: empty fields -> 'Fill in name, phone, address'; phone '12' -> "Invalid phone number '12'"; '99999 Nowhere Blvd Zzz' -> 'Address not found in Kitchener-Waterloo — check the street and number'. The sheet stays open and keeps the typed values. A valid entry with priority and amount 20.00 gave the toast 'DELIVERY MC14378 ADDED · CA$24.99' and closed the sheet. ORDERS went from 2 to 3, the row shows the PRIORITY pill, the 14:30–18:00 window and 'CUSTOMER PAYS CA$20.00 + HST', and the afternoon batch tracker went from 0/10 to 1/10. Reopening the sheet gives an empty form, and the X closes it. Admin view of mer-1 (non-pharmacy): no run label, and the date and window fields show. Window from only -> 'Give both window_start and window_end, or neither'; past date -> 'window_date is in the past'; valid entry -> 'DELIVERY MC13505 ADDED · CA$8.99' and ORDERS went from 2 to 3. The gate code was saved for that customer (GET saved-notes confirmed). No deprecated Expo packages found. No page errors.

issues: Some backend errors use raw field names that don't match the form labels: 'Give both window_start and window_end, or neither' and 'window_date is in the past'. The fields are labelled WINDOW FROM / WINDOW TO / DELIVERY DATE. Consider mapping these to the label wording in the form (CSV users may still want the column names).

On web the priority Pressable (accessibilityRole=checkbox, accessibilityState.checked) has no aria-checked attribute (it reads None even when checked). Accessibility only; the feature works (PRIORITY pill appears).

The runLabel is fixed when the sheet opens ('... TODAY'). If the run's cut-off passes while the sheet is open, the backend's runs_today() moves the order to tomorrow, but the label still says today. Edge case, low priority.

action_items: (Optional, low) Show friendlier wording in the manual-entry sheet for window/date errors ('Give both WINDOW FROM and WINDOW TO, or neither', 'Delivery date is in the past').
(Optional, low) Make the priority checkbox's checked state reachable on web (aria-checked).
critical_code_review_comments: NewDeliverySheet.tsx (98 lines) is clean: client-side required check, Btn disables while loading (no double submit), error box outside the scroll so it is always visible above the save button, and testIDs on every control.

The slide animation takes about 300-500 ms on web. Automated tests must wait before tapping new-delivery-save, or it reports 'outside of viewport' while the sheet slides in. Once open, the layout fits 375x667 (save button at y=595).
